scenario.topic: Choose the group costume for the fan convention

options.name: Classic Superhero Squad
options.upside: Widely recognized characters with moderate costume complexity.
options.concern: Some costumes may require custom fitting to ensure comfort.

options.name: Famous Anime Characters
options.upside: Costumes allow good mobility and appeal to niche fans.
options.concern: Complex designs may require more preparation time and materials.

options.name: Iconic Video Game Heroes

shared_context: The group of 6 is choosing a costume theme for the upcoming fan convention. Each costume option should accommodate all members, be recognizable, and allow moderate mobility during the event.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is an experienced cosplayer who values simplicity and comfort.
personas.private_goal: To enjoy the convention without feeling restricted by the costume.

A.reason_for: Widely recognized and moderate complexity suits group needs.
A.reason_against: Some costumes may require custom fitting which could reduce comfort.

B.reason_against: High costume complexity and preparation time are concerns.

C.reason_against: Moderate mobility might still be restrictive.

D.reason_for: Simple costumes with low complexity and easy assembly.

personas.background: Liam is a fan of classic superhero stories and enjoys group themes.
personas.private_goal: To have a recognizable and fun group costume that everyone enjoys.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe prefers costumes that are easy to wear and low effort.
personas.private_goal: To participate without spending too much time on costume preparation.

D.reason_for: Simple, low complexity, easy to assemble.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli enjoys iconic video game characters and values moderate mobility.
personas.private_goal: To wear a costume that allows moving comfortably throughout the event.

C.reason_for: Balanced complexity and moderate mobility suit active participation.

D.reason_against: Low mobility is a significant drawback.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is passionate about video games and prefers costumes that reflect that interest.
personas.private_goal: To showcase iconic characters with a balance of comfort and style.

C.reason_for: Recognizable video game heroes with balanced complexity.

personas.background: Omar prefers straightforward costumes that don't hinder movement.
personas.private_goal: To stay comfortable and mobile while still fitting the group theme.

D.reason_for: Simple, low complexity costumes with easy assembly.
